name: Urgency_Requests
label: Urgency Requests
_about: Manual urgency (spec 05 Shared Engines / 01 Sorting Engine section 7, MU-1 to MU-6; 01 Database urgency_requests). A sales agent or supervisor asks for urgency with a name and a reason; a supervisor approves with a name. Approved and not expired = the order sorts first INSIDE its own category (never above a higher category, never past a gate). It expires after the Target Delivery date, or 14 days after approval when there is no target. It can be raised by hand, never lowered by hand. Checked by app/fulfillment/urgency.py.

fields.name: Reason
fields.label: Reason
fields.helpText: Required (MU-1): VIP, project deadline, relationship call.

fields.name: Requested_By
fields.label: Requested by
fields.helpText: Required (MU-1): the name of the sales agent or supervisor.

fields.name: Approved_By
fields.label: Decided by
fields.helpText: The supervisor who approved (or rejected) it.

fields.name: Expires_On
fields.label: Expires on
fields.helpText: Set by the server when it is approved: the Target Delivery date, or 14 days later when there is none (MU-2).
